regime_context: The detector shows a broad but uncoordinated TSX advance: Oil & Gas Producers and Base Metals & Copper both sit above the eligibility gate as the top two, but rotation leadership is shallow (margin 0.223), one_narrative is false, and breadth is only slightly above half. The validated absolute-trend gate does help on this market's history, so trend-eligibility is a legitimate risk filter here, but rank-IC is weak and rotation-timing has no forward edge — this is a discipline/risk lens, not an alpha call.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper can actually overtake Oil & Gas Producers as confirmed leader; the rank margin is narrow (0.223) but the rotation leg is display-only, so the watch retires only if Base Metals holds rank 1 for five consecutive sessions while Oil & Gas producers' score decays.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: This is the prevailing narrative leader by the rank leg (score 1.768) and it clears the absolute-trend gate (eligible true), which is the one validated leg on this market. Durability is moderate (0.62) and breadth is decent (0.643), suggesting the leadership is not a one-name spike. Crowding (z 1.01, crowded true) is a sizing caution only — I cap enthusiasm, not fade it.
theses.dissent: The leader is crowded and cross-sectional momentum rank has ~0 IC on clean sectors; the top-two margin is thin (0.223) and hurst_tag is 'mixed', so this could just be late-cycle attention concentration rather than durable trend.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO reverses and closes below its 50-day average while Oil & Gas Producers drops out of rank 1 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: This is the challenger in the rotation leg (rank 2, score 1.545), clearing the trend gate with meaningful separation from laggards. It is not crowded (z 0.89), so no reflexivity caution applies, and its score remains positive. However the hurst_tag 'mean-revert' and moderate durability (0.52) argue for treating this purely as a trend-filter-eligible leg, not a forecast.
evidence: challenger in rotation leg with margin 0.223
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert and durability is only 0.52 — copper/base metals can whipsaw hard on global growth news, and the rotation leg itself is display-only with no validated handoff edge.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO falls below its 50-day average and Base Metals & Copper drops below Gold Miners in the rank leg before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is crowded (z 1.23, the highest in the set) while its score is negative (-0.197). Although it is eligible under the trend gate, the negative momentum rank combined with crowding makes this the classic 'do not chase the crowded laggard' setup. This is an avoidance lean, not a short — guardrails forbid fading.
evidence: eligible=true but no positive trend to follow
theses.dissent: High durability (0.69) and breadth (0.70) suggest the theme still has structural participation — tech may simply be range-bound and could resume leadership if a macro rotation fires.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO closes above its 20-day average with a positive 5-day return and Technology's score turns positive before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
